## Details

<a id="cart_cold_start_vector"></a>
### [`cart_cold_start_vector`](../../../../src/init/cartridge_header.asm#L6) `$8000-$8001`

*vector*

Cartridge header. At a hardware reset, the KERNAL finds the signature at $8004 and jumps through the cold start vector.
Cold start address: $8009.

<a id="cart_warm_start_vector"></a>
### [`cart_warm_start_vector`](../../../../src/init/cartridge_header.asm#L8) `$8002-$8003`

*vector*

Warm start address: $8009. RESTORE does not use it: the game sets the NMI vector to an RTI.

<a id="cartridge_signature"></a>
### [`cartridge_signature`](../../../../src/init/cartridge_header.asm#L10) `$8004-$8008`

*data*

The signature CBM80 (C, B, M with bit 7 set, then 8 and 0).

- **Referred to by:** [`$8000`](../../../../src/init/cartridge_header.asm#L7)
